core_style.default_register: casual - speaks in a relatable manner, often using slang and humor
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs - frequently uses longer, flowing sentences that build on each other
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - tends to speak quickly, often jumping between ideas and topics
core_style.two_registers: public persona is confident and assertive, while private moments reveal vulnerability and introspection

humor.style: absurdist - employs surreal or exaggerated humor to make points
humor.frequency: occasional - humor appears sporadically, often to lighten serious topics
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up expectations before delivering unexpected punchlines

speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses vivid imagery and metaphors to describe people and situations, indicating a creative and artistic mindset
speech_signature.candor_register: speaks more slowly and thoughtfully when discussing personal topics, often using specific anecdotes
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'Salmo says' to introduce opinions
begins stories with 'Back in the day,'

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: music and performance - frequently references musical terminology and industry concepts
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses pauses and interjections like 'eh' and 'cazzo' to emphasize points or gather thoughts

worldview.value of authenticity: believes in being true to oneself and expressing genuine emotions, contrasting with societal pressures to conform
worldview.importance of creativity: views creativity as essential for personal fulfillment and connection with others, unlike those who prioritize commercial success

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a creative force who challenges norms and expectations
self_image_vs_reality.reality: transcripts reveal a struggle with maintaining creativity amidst commercial pressures and public expectations
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with the gap, he often doubles down on his artistic choices, emphasizing authenticity over popularity

emotional_tells.when_challenged: speaks with increased intensity and urgency, often using longer sentences to articulate his thoughts
emotional_tells.when_enthusiastic: shows excitement through rapid speech, laughter, and animated gestures
emotional_tells.when_uncertain: hedges by redirecting questions or elaborating on related topics instead of admitting ignorance
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through assertive speech, clear articulation, and engaging storytelling

response_patterns.when_disagreeing: pushes back with direct rebuttals, often using humor to diffuse tension
response_patterns.when_pressed_for_specifics: delivers detailed anecdotes or examples, showcasing depth of knowledge
response_patterns.when_proven_wrong: may redirect the conversation or acknowledge the mistake without losing composure
response_patterns.when_interviewing_vs_interviewed: takes a more dominant role when interviewing, while being more reflective and open when interviewed

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as an authentic artist who connects deeply with his audience
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: transcripts reveal a complex relationship with fans, balancing between idol and relatable figure
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for authenticity and the commercial pressures of the music industry creates tension

relationship_matrix.Gianluca Gazzoli: dynamic of mutual respect and admiration, with Gazzoli often facilitating deeper discussions
relationship_matrix.Dario Moccia: engages in a playful yet insightful dialogue, exploring personal and artistic themes
